decisions.dropped: a decision any batch drops, or missing from the NLL4-TF inputs, is dropped from every statistic and listed
decisions.rule: the G8 hours (D.hour % 8 == 0) of the fold's inner validation [inner start, CSV end); each decision's 512 context candles and 4 targets open inside the CSV range

fans.seeds: kronos_agent.seeds of D, the stream and the project symbol (pilot and shipped share the forecast stream: common random numbers)

intervals: the decisions touch 3 four-week blocks, fewer than the 20 an interval needs (D-035): point estimates only
nll_inputs: the pilot export's nll_inputs.npz (its sha256 verified) restricted to the decisions

projection.label: approximate
projection.n_eff: decisions / phases / inflation: the 8-hour autocorrelation applied to one of the two 8-hour phases of G4, the second phase counted as adding no information; the 27 four-week blocks not modelled

reading.no_go: the fine-tune barely changed the model; the work stops and the owner chooses: run anyway as a measured null; the GPU with the template budget; or lr 4e-5
reading.source: SPEC 12's live-against-replay success level for 'the same system'

role.text: the named model-period opt-in 'pilot-check' (docs/RETRAINING.md 6.2): the shipped weights forecast hours before their cutoff and the pilot hours inside its own inner validation, training-segment hours where no skill is read

statistics.a_floor: share of decisions where signal(shipped, forecast) == signal(shipped, forecast-aa)
statistics.a_same: share of decisions where signal(pilot, forecast) == signal(shipped, forecast)
statistics.d: d(D) = CRPS_pilot - CRPS_shipped at h = 4, stream forecast, fair CRPS (K = 20) of x_k = 1e4 log(close_k(4) / c_ref) against y = 1e4 log(close(D + 3 h) / c_ref), in bp; c_ref and the realised close are rows 511 and 515 of the NLL4-TF inputs; a fan with a close <= 0 or not finite drops its decision from d (counted)
statistics.d_mean_bp: descriptive only: no skill is read from it
statistics.kl_pilot_shipped: mean over decisions of sum p_pilot (log p_pilot - log p_shipped) of the step-0 s1 distributions (teacher-forced logits, the shipped tokenizer, log_softmax in float64, T = 1, no top-p); the primary KL
statistics.nll4_tf_curve: per pseudo-epoch NLL4-TF, training loss and vendored validation loss of the fold record (epoch 0 = the shipped weights), the selected pseudo-epoch and the stop reason
statistics.relative_weight_change: sqrt(sum_t ||theta_pilot,t - theta_0,t||^2) / sqrt(sum_t ||theta_0,t||^2) over every floating tensor of model.state_dict(), float64; with the share of tensors changed and max |delta|
